items.q: What kinds of engagements are you open to?
items.a: Full-time Senior Data Analyst, BI Developer, or Data / Analytics Engineer. Open to contract too: analytics audits, KPI design, BI builds, pipeline and warehouse work.

Production BI semantic models, ETL/ELT pipelines on Snowflake and Redshift, identity-resolution systems, real-time data delivery, and exec dashboards across B2B SaaS, IoT/telecom, and nonprofit operations.

items.q: Do you do analysis, BI, or engineering?
items.a: All three. I write the SQL, model the warehouse, build the dashboards, run the A/B tests, then turn what they say into a clear recommendation.

items.q: What does your typical process look like?
items.a: Pin the metric, get the data and context, frame the KPI tree, instrument it, ship the smallest thing that proves the answer, then measure honestly and roll forward or back.
